m: Score the duck skin in a crisscross without cutting into the meat. Rub with five spice and salt. Leave 20 minutes.
Place the duck skin side down in a cold pan, then turn the heat to medium. Cook 8 to 10 minutes, pouring off the fat as it renders, until the skin is deep golden and crisp.
Flip and cook 3 to 4 minutes for pink. Rest 8 minutes on a board.
Glaze: soy, honey and grated ginger bubbled in the pan for 1 minute. Stir-fry the halved bok choy with garlic in a little of the duck fat for 2 minutes.
Slice the duck, spoon over the glaze, and serve with rice, bok choy, spring onion and sesame seeds.
l: Slice the duck thin over rice and greens. Good cold or barely warm.
g: Tamari instead of soy for the GF glaze, made in a separate pan. Check the five spice.
